items.title: Gloria Steinem's most repeated quotes — and the one she never penned

children.content: Gloria Steinem was a trailblazing figure in women's liberation with words and impact that echoed across the globe.
As a second-wave feminist figure, the US advocate helped advance the cause of women worldwide.
Her death has been met with tributes from leading women, including former US secretary of state Hilary Clinton.
"Gloria Steinem pushed open doors not just for herself, but for literally millions of women behind her," Ms Clinton said.
